rules.title: Just Cause Required for Termination of Tenancy (San Diego Municipal Code Ch. 9, Art. 8, Div. 7)
rules.requirement: Landlords terminating a tenancy must give notices stating cause, an opportunity to cure for curable at-fault violations, and notice to the Commission. For no-fault terminations they must provide relocation assistance (direct payment or rent waiver), a right to an offer to renew within five years, and a tenant protection notice and guide. Buyout agreements are regulated and retaliation is prohibited.
rules.key_value: Relocation assistance for no-fault termination: 2 months' rent (3 months if tenant is senior or disabled)
rules.penalty: Failure to comply voids the termination notice; wrongful eviction damages of at least 3x actual economic damages; at least 3x relocation assistance plus actual damages if not paid; attorney's fees and costs; City enforcement with civil and criminal remedies.
rules.citation: San Diego Municipal Code §§98.0705-98.0710; O-21647 N.S.; O-21769 N.S.
rules.status_basis: Added 5-25-2023 by O-21647 N.S.; effective 6-24-2023; amended 2-27-2024 by O-21769 N.S.; effective 3-28-2024.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental property subject to the Division; the applicability and exemption terms are not in this chunk.
